name: autryn
description: Autryn is a lightweight, extensible AI Agent Runtime. It includes an Agent Loop, a Coding Agent, and a CLI.
author: zijie1024 <opensource@zijie1024.com>

scripts.build:package: rm -rf dist/package && bun run build:library && bun pm pack --destination dist/package
scripts.build:library: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:types: rm -rf dist/types && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.types.json
scripts.release:github:assets: bun run build:package && bun run build:bin:all
scripts.build:js: rm -rf dist/js && bun build ./index.ts --outdir ./dist/js --splitting --target bun && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/index.js --target bun && bun build ./src/core/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/core.js --target bun && bun build ./src/runtime/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/runtime.js --target bun && bun build ./src/sessions/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/session.js --target bun && bun build ./src/coding/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/coding.js --target bun && bun build ./src/memory/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/memory.js --target bun && bun build ./src/providers/openai/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/providers/openai.js --target bun && bun build ./src/providers/anthropic/index.ts --outfile ./dist/js/lib/providers/anthropic.js --target bun
